title: RSC at IEEE RO-MAN 2025
excerpt: The Robot Study Companion took part in IEEE RO-MAN 2025, bringing together members of the RSC team for research presentations and the robot design competition.
content:
🇳🇱 **IEEE RO-MAN Conference 2025 – A remarkable achievement for the Robot[ic] Study Companion in Eindhoven!**

From August 25 to 29, the international conference brought together leading researchers and developers to explore how to shape our hybrid future with robots.

The RSC ([rsc.ee](https://rsc.ee)) team stood out in several ways:

- 🏆 The team won the **Best Technical Design Award** with the project *'Say Hi to the RSC (v4.1); the study buddy you (can) build (and fix)!'*. At the robot design competition, Matevž Zorec and Farnaz Baksh presented the RSC team, supported by Feiazie Baksh (poster and slides) and Ali Badshah (documentation).
- 🔹 Farnaz Baksh gave a session talk at the Robots for Humans (RfH) Workshop.
- 🔹 Miriam Calafa' presented the RSC team's research paper *Emotive Design of the RSC*.

🤖 A **robotic study companion (RSC)** is a social robot that adapts to students’ academic and emotional needs, providing personalised support, feedback, and motivation to enhance learning and foster a more engaging study environment.
